trello.name: Frontend checkout and pricing page integration
trello.desc: Jordan will implement the Stripe Elements checkout form matching the app's design, handle errors gracefully (invalid card details, insufficient funds), and update the pricing page to reflect the three subscription tiers (Basic $29/mo, Pro $49/mo, Enterprise $99/mo). The pricing page must include a clear feature comparison for each tier, a prominent checkout button, and a tooltip or help icon explaining what happens if users choose a different plan later. Initial integration target: within two weeks.

trello.name: User dashboard development
trello.desc: Jordan will build the user dashboard to display current plan details and billing info, provide options to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel subscriptions, give access to invoices and payment history, allow updating payment methods, reflect current subscription status in real-time, and notify users of changes such as successful plan upgrades or payment failures. Dashboard must be intuitive and integrated with the backend API for real-time updates.

trello.name: Backend Stripe API integration
trello.desc: Taylor will integrate Stripe's API to handle creating and managing subscriptions, processing successful and failed payments, and managing webhooks. Specific webhook events to handle: invoice.payment_succeeded (confirm payments, activate/continue subscription), invoice.payment_failed (notify users, prompt payment info update, send email notification), and customer.subscription.deleted (update access rights, offer re-subscription). Initial integration target: within two weeks.

trello.name: Test plan preparation
trello.desc: Taylor will prepare a detailed test plan covering both manual and automated tests for the entire subscription flow from sign-up to billing to subscription management. The plan should include test scenarios simulating different events such as payment failures and cancellations, and will be shared with Alex and Jordan. Testing phase target: one week after initial integration is complete.

trello.name: API and webhook documentation
trello.desc: Taylor will document the API endpoints and webhook event handlers to make future maintenance and troubleshooting easier.

trello.name: User documentation and help section
trello.desc: Jordan and team will create a help section or FAQ covering common issues and questions about subscriptions, with clear instructions for users on how to manage their subscriptions, access invoices, and handle any issues once the integration is live.

trello.name: Schedule follow-up meeting
trello.desc: Alex will set up a follow-up meeting for next week to review progress on the Stripe integration and address any issues or blockers.
